controller_notes.SDMMC_SLOT0/SDMMC_SLOT1: one S3 SD/MMC host exposes slot 0 up to 8-bit and slot 1 up to 4-bit through the GPIO matrix; two 4-bit links remain one scheduled-controller concurrency gate
controller_notes.I2C1_OR_UART0_OR_GPIO: historical candidates only: GPIO7/8 use the S3 second hardware I2C controller, UART0 through the GPIO matrix or custom GPIO as one mutually exclusive Unit profile
controller_notes.I2C1_OR_UART1_OR_GPIO: current G2F-3I Unit profile: GPIO7/8 use the S3 second hardware I2C controller, UART1 through the GPIO matrix or custom GPIO; default UART0 remains dedicated to service GPIO43/44
controller_notes.UART0: default service and RF-test route on exposed GPIO43=U0TXD and GPIO44=U0RXD

ANT.physical: first-generation on-module receptacle compatible with U.FL/MHF I/AMC

unavailable_gpio.GPIO22..GPIO34: not exposed by this module; GPIO26..GPIO32 are module-memory signals

rf_connector.secondary_path: ANT2 pad default-disabled; not a second baseline external connector

controller_notes.SPI2_OR_GPIO: the shared data pin changes between GP-SPI2 MOSI and software latch-data mode; concurrent use is not implied
controller_notes.SDIO_SLAVE_4BIT: fixed C5 signals: CLK GPIO9, CMD GPIO10, DAT0 GPIO8, DAT1 GPIO7, DAT2 GPIO14 and DAT3 GPIO13; GPIO13/14 therefore cannot simultaneously provide native USB

ANT1.physical: first-generation on-module receptacle compatible with U.FL/MHF I/AMC (default path)

unavailable_gpio.GPIO15: bonded to internal PSRAM as SPICS1 on the N8R8 module
unavailable_gpio.GPIO16..GPIO22: not exposed by this module variant

controller_notes.PIO1_SM0_EXT_SPI: independent physical U214 SPI group; PIO1 has its own selectable 32-GPIO window and no display or compatibility-radio sharing
controller_notes.PIO1_SM1_IPC_UART: independent full-duplex framed IPC UART with CTS/RTS flow control; 16 Mbaud target stays below the S3 GPIO-matrix >40 MHz direct-IO threshold
controller_notes.SPI1_IPC: hardware SPI1 exact mux on GPIO24 RX, GPIO25 CSn, GPIO26 SCK and GPIO27 TX
